temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian and reveals that he is in some trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from me.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Christian's suspicion is confirmed and clarified: Jonathan was hiding that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been concealing serious trouble from me; he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious, then worried and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To understand what trouble Jonathan is in and support him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but eventually admits he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and has been hiding it; he may need help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Jonathan explicitly accepts support/resources and confirms the trouble is complicated.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in a complicated trouble and needs support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help and support Jonathan, including providing resources so he can get out of the mess.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure, but he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, though he insists he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in a complicated trouble and needs support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Christian now suspects the trouble may be related to criminal or wrong-people involvement, while Jonathan denies illegal actions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people or criminal activity, but he may not have done anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed, and he tells Jonathan that someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be involved with wrong people or criminal activity, and it is unclear whether he is guilty.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Christian moves from uncertainty to believing Jonathan is innocent and is being framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by someone, and evidence is needed to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence and clear Jonathan's name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian finds out that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan, and he tells Jonathan this.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed, but the person responsible is unknown.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. The culprit is identified as someone close to and trusted by both Christian and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close and trusted by both Christian and Jonathan is behind the frame-up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
